fields.execution_identity_semantics: One Source business execution identity; transport delivery does not mint another identity.
fields.operation_protocol_semantics: Independent of model name and protocol transport retries.
fields.capability_evidence_semantics: Does not prove a capability by itself.
fields.route_attempt_semantics: Parent identity for zero or more provider attempts.
fields.usage_semantics: Usage facts reference this identity and are not copied as new facts.
fields.cost_pricing_reconciliation_semantics: Cost and later reconciliation reference this identity without replacing terminal facts.
fields.outcome_finality_semantics: At most one terminal Source fact per source fact identity.
fields.provenance: Direct Source identity or explicit deterministic derivation only.
fields.ordering: Stable across duplicate delivery and polling.
fields.absence_gap_unknown_semantics: Missing identity rejects the candidate; it cannot be synthesized from time.

revision_of.rule: Execution identity is not a revision counter.

supersedes.rule: Correction facts may supersede facts; the execution identity remains stable.

relates_to.rule: A later lifecycle event may reference the same execution.

derived_from.rule: Only with exact input identity and algorithm provenance.

fields.execution_identity_semantics: Describes the operation bound to the execution identity.
fields.operation_protocol_semantics: Exact operation family, profile, protocol version, capability type and execution profile version.
fields.capability_evidence_semantics: Names the observed capability surface but does not claim support without evidence.
fields.route_attempt_semantics: Attempts must remain within the declared operation and profile.
fields.usage_semantics: Determines which usage units may be observed, never how to invent them.
fields.cost_pricing_reconciliation_semantics: Does not select pricing or recompute charges.
fields.ordering: Declared before attempt and fact interpretation.
fields.absence_gap_unknown_semantics: Unknown versions are explicit and cannot fall back by model name.
fields.idempotency_identity: Included in candidate fixture identity, not a transport key.

revision_of.rule: A profile change is a new version, not a transport revision.

supersedes.rule: Version selection does not correct prior facts.

relates_to.rule: May relate fixtures for the same operation family.

derived_from.rule: Only exact versioned Source metadata may be transformed.

fields.execution_identity_semantics: Attached to one execution without becoming its identity.
fields.operation_protocol_semantics: Bound to the exact operation/profile tuple.
fields.capability_evidence_semantics: Known requires a reference and raw content hash; gap and unknown require null reference.
fields.route_attempt_semantics: Does not choose a route or provider.
fields.outcome_finality_semantics: Does not imply success or terminality.
fields.provenance: Reference plus content digest when known.
fields.absence_gap_unknown_semantics: gap and unknown are first-class and never auto-filled.
fields.idempotency_identity: Reference digest is content identity, not delivery identity.

revision_of.rule: Only a Source-declared revision of the same capability fact.

supersedes.rule: Only a correction of an erroneous prior reference.

caused_by.rule: Capability membership does not imply cause.

derived_from.rule: Exact upstream reference and provenance are required.

fields.evidence_reference: Draft fixtures and exact Source refs where available

fields.execution_identity_semantics: Attempt identities are children of one execution, not replacement executions.
fields.operation_protocol_semantics: Attempt provider and route stay under the declared protocol profile.
fields.capability_evidence_semantics: Attempt presence does not prove general capability support.
fields.route_attempt_semantics: Ordinal is contiguous; predispatch denial has no provider attempt.
fields.usage_semantics: Attempt usage remains Source evidence and is not summed unless declared.
fields.cost_pricing_reconciliation_semantics: Attempt cost does not become customer charge without Source finality.
fields.outcome_finality_semantics: Failed attempts may precede one terminal success or cancellation.
fields.absence_gap_unknown_semantics: Zero attempts is valid only for predispatch outcomes.

revision_of.rule: Retry is a new attempt, not a Source fact revision.

supersedes.rule: Fallback does not erase a failed attempt.

caused_by.rule: Only an explicit Source parent event and exact identity.

relates_to.rule: Request or attempt association stays non-causal.

derived_from.rule: Only deterministic conversion with input identities.

fields.evidence_reference: Pinned UniRouter execution evidence code observations

fields.execution_identity_semantics: One usage Source fact per source identity.
fields.capability_evidence_semantics: Usage is evidence for one execution, not support breadth.
fields.route_attempt_semantics: Attempt attribution is preserved when Source declares it.
fields.usage_semantics: No duplicate total or inferred missing units.
fields.outcome_finality_semantics: Streaming usage is accepted only at Source terminal finality.
fields.ordering: After attempt observations and at terminal finality.
fields.absence_gap_unknown_semantics: Missing terminal usage is gap/unknown, never zero.

supersedes.rule: Only explicit correction, preserving prior fact.

caused_by.rule: Token totals do not prove causality.

relates_to.rule: May relate to the terminal fact.

derived_from.rule: Exact upstream usage facts and algorithm identity required.

fields.evidence_reference: completed-execution V1 usage fixture at pinned Source commit

fields.execution_identity_semantics: Financial facts retain separate Source fact identities.
fields.capability_evidence_semantics: Financial evidence does not prove model capability.
fields.route_attempt_semantics: Provider observation and customer charge are not conflated.
fields.usage_semantics: Cost may reference usage but never duplicate it.
fields.cost_pricing_reconciliation_semantics: Refund and reconciliation are later lifecycle facts and do not overwrite the terminal charge.
fields.ordering: Post-terminal facts sequence after the terminal fact.
fields.absence_gap_unknown_semantics: Unknown charge is not zero and is never back-calculated.

revision_of.rule: Only same Source fact revision; transport retry is excluded.

supersedes.rule: Only correction facts may supersede an erroneous financial fact.

relates_to.rule: Refund normally relates to original terminal charge.

derived_from.rule: Exact inputs and algorithm identity required for X-Insight test derivation.

fields.evidence_reference: completed-execution V1 money and synthetic post-terminal cases

fields.execution_identity_semantics: Outcome binds to the existing execution identity.
fields.operation_protocol_semantics: Finality is Source-declared for the operation/profile.
fields.capability_evidence_semantics: One success does not prove general support.
fields.route_attempt_semantics: Predispatch denial has zero attempts; terminal outcome follows attempts when present.
fields.cost_pricing_reconciliation_semantics: Outcome does not synthesize customer charge.
fields.outcome_finality_semantics: Exactly one predispatch or terminal outcome Source fact.
fields.ordering: Terminal outcome precedes post-terminal lifecycle facts.
fields.absence_gap_unknown_semantics: Unknown finality is rejected, not guessed from time.

revision_of.rule: Only a Source revision of the same fact.

supersedes.rule: Only a correction fact may supersede an erroneous prior outcome.

caused_by.rule: Requires explicit Source declaration and exact parent identity.

fields.execution_identity_semantics: Preserves the Source fact identity for each fact.
fields.route_attempt_semantics: Binds attempt-derived facts to exact inputs.
fields.usage_semantics: Prevents inferred usage from appearing direct.
fields.cost_pricing_reconciliation_semantics: Prevents recomputed cost from appearing Source-final.
fields.outcome_finality_semantics: Prevents time order from appearing causal or terminal.
fields.provenance: direct, source_declared, or xinsight_test_derived with algorithm identity.
fields.ordering: Travels with the fact and is immutable.

revision_of.rule: Revision keeps exact same Source fact identity lineage.

supersedes.rule: Correction records both old and new identities.

caused_by.rule: Only Source declaration plus event identity.

derived_from.rule: Source-declared derivation needs upstream provenance; X-Insight derivation also needs algorithm identity.

fields.execution_identity_semantics: Lifecycle facts share execution identity without overwriting each other.
fields.operation_protocol_semantics: Lifecycle is independent of transport cursor and poll retries.
fields.capability_evidence_semantics: Lifecycle state does not prove capability breadth.
fields.cost_pricing_reconciliation_semantics: Refund and reconciliation must be post_terminal.
fields.outcome_finality_semantics: Original terminal remains immutable after later lifecycle facts.
fields.provenance: Source sequence or exact deterministic transform.
fields.ordering: Strict fact sequence and lifecycle rank.
fields.absence_gap_unknown_semantics: Absent lifecycle rejects; cursor/checkpoint are not evidence lifecycle.

revision_of.rule: Revision is not delivery attempt or cursor progress.

fields.operation_protocol_semantics: Relationship semantics do not vary by model name.
fields.capability_evidence_semantics: A relation is not capability support evidence.
fields.route_attempt_semantics: Request ID or time proximity remains relates_to.
fields.usage_semantics: Usage relation does not duplicate totals.
fields.cost_pricing_reconciliation_semantics: Refund relates_to terminal; it does not supersede terminal.
fields.outcome_finality_semantics: caused_by requires explicit Source parent and exact event identity.
fields.provenance: Each relation records whether Source declared it.
fields.ordering: Relations do not infer causality from sequence.
fields.absence_gap_unknown_semantics: Missing causal evidence downgrades to relates_to, never upgrades.
fields.idempotency_identity: Relationship identity is subordinate to the fact.

caused_by.rule: Source-declared plus exact source event identity.

relates_to.rule: Request ID, time proximity, same attempt or general association.

derived_from.rule: Upstream fact and transform provenance required.
